versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-bulk-processor: a bulk GEO content orchestration skill.

- Enables large-scale GEO optimization across thousands of pages or documents.
- Supports ingestion of sitemaps, URL lists, spreadsheets, or content exports.
- Guides users in designing batch pipelines, reusable page templates, and phased rollout strategies.
- Facilitates structured planning, quality control, and implementation specifications for bulk content updates.
- Integrates conceptually with other geo-* skills for end-to-end scalable GEO workflows.
